paragraph: Oradell is a single-family market, plain and simple. Thirty-one sales over six months at a median of $999,000, with a sale-to-list ratio of 1.11 and a median of 12 days on market. Roughly 94 percent of homes sold above asking. That is a real seller's market, and buyers should expect competition on the good ones. The typical sale is a three-bedroom, two-bath split-level or colonial, and the range runs from $740,000 to $1,665,000, so anchor on the median. The monthly series tracks the normal arc: the winter and early spring months are too thin to read, volume built to 12 closings in June, and July came in at eight with a median of $930,500. If Oradell follows the usual pattern, expect volume to taper modestly through fall and thin out in deep winter, with pricing power staying with sellers as long as inventory stays this tight.
